title: Correlated Capacity
description: Synthetic toy simulation (classical software, not physical holography hardware). Classification capacity of the complex outer-product holographic memory under correlated pattern families: a shared-direction family with calibrated energy fraction rho and a rank-8 subspace family. P90 (largest pattern count with accuracy >= 0.90) collapses as correlation rises: random patterns are the best case.
notes: Synthetic toy simulation; classical software. Not physical holography or quantum hardware.
